__doc: Floors per model for the share of replies handled right on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.
floor = observed - 2 binomial SE over the 70 conversations, rounded down, like evals/kody-rules/kody-targets.json.
deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-15 from 4 runs of the same classifier: 3 local
(68, 68, 68 of 70; the same two missed, rhetorical-comment and pr-template-text, both expected respond) and the
first CI run of the shared nightly job (66 of 70, run 38658146036). Mean 96.4%. No reply meant for someone else
was answered in the local runs. One CI run already moved 2 cases, so the margin is the binomial SE, not zero.
RATCHET: when a PR moves this on purpose, recalibrate here with two runs as evidence.
